Root cause: constant folding evaluated custom filters and tests at compile time, but only converted `TypeError` and `ValueError` into `Impossible`, allowing other exceptions to escape during template loading.

Changed `_FilterTestCommon.as_const` to treat all regular `Exception` subclasses as non-constant expressions. This defers evaluation to rendering while preserving compile-time optimization for valid constants and existing behavior for invalid built-in arguments.

Tests: `166 passed`.

final_text:
Root cause: constant folding evaluated custom filters and tests at compile time, but only converted `TypeError` and `ValueError` into `Impossible`, allowing other exceptions to escape during template loading.

Changed `_FilterTestCommon.as_const` to treat all regular `Exception` subclasses as non-constant expressions. This defers evaluation to rendering while preserving compile-time optimization for valid constants and existing behavior for invalid built-in arguments.

Tests: `166 passed`.
